name: Volume Ray Casting with RayData Texture
definition: Rendering fluid stored in a 3D texture by casting rays through the simulation volume, using a precomputed RayData texture to store ray entry points and marching distances to facilitate compositing and clipping.
summary: Volume Ray Casting with RayData Texture is a deferred rendering method that pre-computes ray entry and exit data in a dedicated texture to avoid expensive intersection calculations during the final ray marching pass.
